displayName: OCI-LAT-0705: Lateral Movement: PowerShell Remoting Followed by Credential Dumping
description:
Correlation rule detecting powershell remoting followed by credential dumping

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_lateral_movement_lat_0705", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
